papers.title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
papers.summary: Addresses RL-trained search agents that skip external retrieval and fall back on unreliable internal knowledge. SOAR splits external and internal knowledge into parallel observable streams (Source-Aware Workflow) and adds a Source-Consistent Reward for finer credit assignment. It beats baselines by 7.3% (3B) and 5.4% (7B) and cuts evidence fabrication by 74.8%.

papers.title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
papers.summary: Surveys safety for LLM agents that keep updating memories, tools, skills and workflows after deployment. Introduces the SAVER transition-centered framework (Substrate, Adaptation, Violation, Exposure, Response). Finds weak evidence on repairing descendant states and calls for longitudinal evaluation of unsafe influence.
